channel.label: Power
channel.description: Switch the dryer on or off when supported by the dryer.

channel.label: Remote Control
channel.description: Whether the dryer currently permits remote control.

channel.label: Power Consumption
channel.description: Instantaneous electrical power reported by the dryer.

channel.label: Cumulative Energy
channel.description: Cumulative energy reported by the dryer.

channel.label: Dryer Mode
channel.description: Current dryer course; supported courses can be selected when Remote Control is enabled.

channel.label: Cycle Control
channel.description: Set the dryer cycle to Run, Pause, or Ready when Remote Control is enabled.

channel.label: Delay End Time
channel.description: Set delay end from 0 to 24 hours in 30-minute increments when Remote Control is enabled.

channel.label: Dry Level
channel.description: Select one of the dry levels supported by the dryer.

channel.label: Remaining Time
channel.description: Remaining dryer cycle duration in seconds.

channel.label: Cycle Progress
channel.description: Dryer cycle progress from 0 to 100 percent.

channel.label: Child Lock
channel.description: Child-lock state reported by the dryer.
